title: 7 Signs You're Not the Same Godly Man in Every Room
caption:
Church version. Gym version. Late-night, phone-in-the-dark version. Pick one, because Scripture only recognizes one of them as real.

A godly man doesn't get louder about his faith in front of an audience and quieter the second it's just him. The version of you that shows up when nobody's checking is the version that's actually true.

You already know which one that is. Let it win somewhere today.
